WITH rental_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_total
  FROM rental_payments
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    rp.store_id,
    rp.payment_total,
    oa.avg_total
  FROM rental_payments rp
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE rp.payment_total > oa.avg_total
)
SELECT 
  aa.store_id,
  SUM(aa.payment_total) AS sum_of_totals,
  AVG(aa.payment_total - aa.avg_total) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average aa
GROUP BY aa.store_id
ORDER BY aa.store_id
